scope: Separate native accuracy2 target. Execution is controlled by scientific gates and root compute allocation under the user's existing authorization, not a new user-permission request.
pilot_prerequisite: Fresh qualified original2000 parent and reconstructed original32 thermal-reviewed genuine1to2 density variation. The pilot may precede completion of the2to3 screen.
full_prerequisite: Everything required by the pilot, successful sealed persistent pilot, and reconstructed same32 accuracy2-to3 screen passing unchanged spread gates with its separate fresh accuracy2 replay. No failed/unknown native attempts.
pilot_point_rule: The two predeclared reference points must differ. No outcome-selected substitute if they coincide.
native_configuration: Use the original factory with correct GPU-first routing and native CAMB. Only AccuracyBoost,lAccuracyBoost,lSampleBoost equal2; all physical parameters, data, priors, calibration, lens settings and actual finalized multipoles remain the original high2 configuration.
model_lifetime: One model per explicitly spawned worker process and static request sequence. No unrecorded warmup, cache clearing, background-only replacement, automatic worker replacement or task resubmission. Pilot tests both process orderings and repeats before the persistent full pool is permitted.
spectra: Archive actual provider rawCl in FIRASmuK2 and dimensionless C_phi_phi; compare native rawCl to converted provider Dl and to the converted original high2 archive. Preserve original Dl files. Require identical ell arrays, finalized theory extra_args, CAMB_Params_max_l and provider length. A conversion/replay failure blocks reuse; never silently recompute.
selection: Keep all original2000 slots, their order, groups, RLE rows, repeated expanded indices, parameter points and immutable original proposal densities. Original32 high2 records are reused at their exact parent slot indices. Remaining1968 slots are new requests even when physical parameter values repeat.
attempts: Fresh work directory and one-use execution receipt. Coordinator writes all request tickets exclusively; each worker atomically claims its own native request. Completed sealed records replay read-only. Any existing claim/log/ticket from an incomplete attempt prevents retry. A claimed request without a completed record has unknown invocation count; an unclaimed ticket has known zero calls. A worker stops after a point failure, preserving remaining unstarted tickets. Other workers may finish their already allocated sequences.
records: Keep native2 full components, priors, total posterior, derived values and raw spectra, original native1 and proposal densities, both rawweight constructions and closure, selected-slot identity, original status for reused records, attempt/process identities, construction/request timings and explicit invocation counts. Invocations are not claimed to equal internal CAMB solver calls.
identity: Distinct nativeaccuracy2 identity binds canonical actual native2configuration, exact original proposal/parent/selected-slot identities, unchanged assets/versions, new source/design/converter hashes, and complete screen/pilot/refinement evidence. No old manifest/settings/result is rewritten.
qualification: The new typed qualifier freshly replays the old parent and all numerical prerequisites, reads every sealed native2 record and raw spectrum, rehashes all prior manifests without resealing changes, recomputes weight algebra and unchanged original importance/chain/batch gates. Only all2000 finite points passing every gate yield QualifiedNativeAccuracy2. New native2 derived values are mandatory. A failed report has posterior=null and remains available as diagnostics.
limits: Fixed32 accuracy2to3 success and finite importance diagnostics do not establish global numerical convergence, missing-mode coverage or empirical model adequacy. No downstream old accuracy1 consumer may accept the new target by filename substitution. Persistent pilot/full execution are not performed during implementation validation.
